Discovering You

Your name, your birth moment and your place on Earth, read together.

Add your birth details to unlock numerology, BaZi, your natal chart, Human Design, tarot, compatibility and more, all drawn from the same moment. Then go further with daily practice, journaling, world wisdom and honest science.

Birth details

Back up or restore profiles

If your phone clears this page's saved data, copy the backup text and keep it in Notes. To restore, paste it back and press Restore.

The form starts with example details, so replace them with your own. Picking a place fills in its coordinates and time zone, and daylight saving for the birth date is worked out for you. Change the time zone if it was different at the time. Numerology uses the name and date. BaZi uses the date, time and offset. The natal chart and map also need the coordinates.

Who to compare

Enter anyone's birth details below — they do not need to be saved. Tick one person to see who fits them best, or two or more to compare them with each other.

    Only a name and a date are required. Without a birth time and place the numerology and Chinese pillars still work, but the rising sign and houses will not.

    Map settings

    Leave the date empty, or press Birth moment, to draw the lines from the exact moment of birth. Pick another date to see where each planet's lines fall for the sky on that day.
